def cashflows(perf, terms):
    import numpy as np

    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths = perf.shape[0]
    n_dates = perf.shape[1]
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)
    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    final_index = int(terms["final_index"])
    downside = terms["downside"]
    upside = terms["upside"]
    buffer = 1.0 - float(downside["level"])
    gearing = float(downside["gearing"])
    leverage = 1.0
    cap = None
    if upside is not None:
        leverage = float(upside["leverage"])
        if upside["cap"] is not None:
            cap = float(upside["cap"])
    final_perf = perf[:, final_index, 0]
    ret = final_perf - 1.0
    payment = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)
    positive = ret > 0.0
    middle = np.logical_and(ret <= 0.0, ret >= -buffer)
    below = ret < -buffer
    if np.any(positive):
        upside_ret = leverage * ret[positive]
        if cap is not None:
            upside_ret = np.minimum(upside_ret, cap)
        payment[positive] = notional * (1.0 + upside_ret)
    if np.any(middle):
        payment[middle] = notional * (1.0 + np.abs(ret[middle]))
    if np.any(below):
        payment[below] = notional * (1.0 + gearing * (ret[below] + buffer))
    payment = np.maximum(payment, 0.0)
    cash[:, final_index] = payment
    return cash
